name: Shankhanaad Trust
tagline: The Pulse of Tradition. The Roar of Devotion.

about.short: Shankhanaad Trust is more than a Dhol-Tasha Pathak; it is a cultural movement dedicated to preserving and amplifying the percussive heritage of Maharashtra. Through thunderous rhythms and disciplined artistry, we bring the spirit of celebration to life.
about.long: Founded with a vision to unite youth through the rich cultural fabric of Maharashtra, Shankhanaad Trust has grown into one of the most respected Dhol-Tasha Pathaks. Our journey is defined by passion, discipline, and an unwavering commitment to our roots. Beyond the performances, we are a family that believes in social responsibility, organizing blood donation camps, environmental drives, and youth empowerment initiatives.

timeline.title: The First Beat
timeline.description: A small group of passionate youth came together with a few dhols, united by their devotion and love for traditional rhythms.

timeline.title: A Cultural Force
timeline.description: Expanded to over 200 members, performing at prestigious Ganesh Mandals across Pune and establishing a unique, disciplined playing style.

timeline.title: Beyond Maharashtra
timeline.description: Represented the vibrant culture of Maharashtra on national platforms, earning recognition for synchronized, energetic performances.

timeline.title: Decade of Devotion
timeline.description: Celebrated our 10th anniversary with a grand performance, launching major social initiatives to give back to the community.

culture.name: Discipline (Shista)
culture.description: The foundation of our Pathak. Every beat, every formation is a testament to rigorous practice and mutual respect.

culture.name: Devotion (Bhakti)
culture.description: We don't just play instruments; we perform as an offering. Our energy stems from a deep-rooted spiritual and cultural devotion.

culture.name: Brotherhood (Bhaichara)
culture.description: Shankhanaad is a family. We stand together, support one another, and grow as a unified force.

people.name: Ajit Tupe
people.bio: The enthusiast who laid the foundation of Shankhanaad with a vision to preserve traditional art.

people.name: Dhol Pramukh
people.bio: Experienced musicians who lead the sections, ensuring every beat resonates with perfection and power.

people.name: Tasha Pramukh
